caseData.headline: Likely: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments

findings.plain: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies

signals.explanation: $461,605 (11.5% of inflows) arrived as 'customer' cash from 'Pioneer Trade Services Inc', an undisclosed company linked to the borrower
